findings.negative_cycles: wrap without decrement; no local fixed-cycle expiry
findings.positive_cycles: decrement on wrap; done when decremented to zero
findings.shield_hit: one hit cycle then restore original run range and counter=-1
findings.ring_identity: owner-state factory constructs TMagicSheild2 using resource122
findings.state_reconciliation: 0x6e2560 retires absent status auras and creates missing desired auras via VMT+4

baseline_gaps: Baseline Godot discards shield and ring after two cycles.
Baseline Godot restores two cycles after shield hit, rather than indefinite run.
Baseline resource exporter selects first run entry and omits later loop continuation.
Baseline server sends shield OFF after10s for both shield and ring; ring needs its own matching termination.
Repeated casts need stale-expiry protection and same-kind attachment replacement.
limits: Negative cycle counter proves local animation persistence, not permanent gameplay protection.
Original authoritative aura removal, duration, absorption and map replay remain unproven.
Current server10s duration is an adapter behavior, not recovered original duration.
Resource122 mapping uses existing independently verified skill identity; it is not an original network capture.
Reconciliation also adds one externally selected effect via0x4f6bcc; that selector and its possible overrides remain unproven.
